text: bhikkhave sappurisena sappurisataroti . [78] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti . evameva kho bhikkhave cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hoti . [79] ko ca bhikkhave cittassa ādhāro . ayamevāriyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi ayaṃ cittassa ādhāro . [80] seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho
